title: Widening the sidewalk under Chongxin Bridge to be completed within 3 months
summary: A pedestrian walkway beneath Chongxin Bridge in Sanchong District, New Taipei City, is only about 1.8 meters wide, causing difficulty for strollers, wheelchairs, and pedestrians, especially during peak hours. After receiving complaints, New Taipei City Councilor Li Weng-yue coordinated with Sanchong District Office, the New Taipei City Public Works Department, and local village heads to conduct a site inspection.
